rows.v_note: FY2025 Bayer collaboration revenue, year ended December 31, 2025: USD 1,422.4 million, comprising USD 1,282.7 million share of profits from EYLEA and EYLEA 8 mg outside the US plus USD 139.7 million manufacturing reimbursements. This is revenue recognized by Regeneron, not Bayer product sales.
rows.v_note_zh: FY2025 Bayer合作收入，截至2025年12月31日的年度：USD 1,422.4 million，包括美国以外EYLEA和EYLEA 8 mg的利润分成USD 1,282.7 million，加生产报销款USD 139.7 million。这是Regeneron确认的收入，并非Bayer产品销售额。
